name: dotnet-specialist
title_zh: 架构级 .NET 疑难杂症会诊，不问语法只救生产事故
tagline_zh: DI 循环、异步死锁、EF 查询爆炸、迁移翻车——它直接给可落地方案。不碰简单 CRUD，专治让你熬夜的深层问题。
tagline_en: Circular DI, async deadlocks, EF query explosions, botched migrations—it gives actionable fixes. Skips trivial.
desc_en: Senior .NET/ASP.NET Core/EF Core specialist for non-trivial architecture, DI, async/concurrency, configuration, HTTP APIs, security, EF queries, transactions, migrations, background work, performance, testing, or production debugging. Do not invoke for trivial syntax, formatting, or isolated simple CRUD edits.
why_zh: 机制上按「非平凡」门槛过滤：只接架构、并发、性能、安全这类多因素耦合问题，回答带权衡分析和迁移路径。
why_en: Filters by a 'non-trivial' bar: only multi-factor issues like architecture, concurrency, perf, security—answers weigh trade-offs.
limit_zh: 不认纯语法、格式化或孤立的小 CRUD 修改；需要你提供 .NET 版本、关键代码片段和异常栈，否则它拒绝空泛作答。
limit_en: Ignores pure syntax, formatting, or isolated CRUD edits. Requires .NET version, key code snippets, and exception stack—otherwise it refuses vague.
title_en: Senior .NET architect for production-grade fixes, not syntax
